name: chamfer-box-edge
description: A 10 x 20 x 30 mm box with its top right edge (along y, 20 mm) beveled 3 mm back on both faces. Checked by hand: volume 6000 - 3 x 3/2 x 20; area 2200 - 2 x 3 x 20 + 3 sqrt(2) x 20 (the bevel) - 2 x 4.5 (the triangle cut from each end face); 7 faces, 15 edges, 10 vertices.
